reuse.why: Adds the flag to the existing getBulkEditableCategories that five actions share; copyPreviousMonth keeps its pre-existing own filter and gets the flag there too.

duplication.why: The hidden toggle is expressed twice (SQL fragment in getBulkEditableCategories, boolean guard in copyPreviousMonth), and the inline { month; includeHiddenCategories? } argument type is repeated six times.

placement.why: The rule change sits in the shared selection helper in budget/actions.ts where the other exclusions live.

scope.why: Only the flag, its plumbing and a release note.

maintainability.why: Workable, but copyPreviousMonth's parallel exclusion list and six copies of the argument type make the next exclusion rule easy to miss in one place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts copyPreviousMonth keeps deciding hidden/template/fixed exclusions itself instead of using getBulkEditableCategories (pre-existing, extended by this diff)

disguised_duplication.where: the hidden rule appears as a SQL clause in getBulkEditableCategories and reshaped as a JS guard on prevBudget.hidden/group_hidden in copyPreviousMonth
